rumours.impact: More usage and minutes for Vezenkov (39.5' on Tuesday) and Fournier; Ward and Ndiaye get Konchar's forward minutes. Bartzokas (OLY) stays a strong coach pick at home.

rumours.text: Mike James is out for 7–9 months (Achilles surgery); Bruno Fernando is out 3–4 weeks (calf).
